product_summary: Website atrasahi.com lists: glass reactors (double-wall, triple-wall, with/without ring baffle, borosilicate); evaporators (short path distillation, thin film, rotary, thermo-syphon); glass Nutsche filters; heat exchangers (glass shell & tube, SiC tube, high-pressure special design, coil condenser, tantalum); glass pipelines, valves and plastic flanges; venturi scrubbers and jet ejectors; gas absorption plants (HCl, SO2, Cl2, HBr); anhydrous HCl gas generation; bromine recovery from NaBr/KBr and from bitterns; sodium hypochlorite production; nitric/sulfuric acid concentration plants, integrated NAC/SAC, denitration with NOx absorption and nitric acid recovery; waste acid from energetic materials; pilot plants, kilo labs, bench-top reactors, laboratory automation; process heat transfer; design & supply of glass pilot process plants. Claimed end-markets: pharma, chemical, fertiliser, defence & aerospace.
comment: HS 841989 is a defensible core code for the engineered process plants (temperature-treatment machinery: distillation, evaporation, acid concentration, gas absorption) and is retained - no rejection on HS grounds per Rule 3. However the declaration is materially incomplete: the company's actual catalogue is dominated by (a) borosilicate glass equipment and glass pipelines/valves (Ch. 70 / 8481), (b) heat exchangers (8419.50), (c) filtration and gas-scrubbing/purification units (8421), and (d) plastic flanges and piping (3917) - none of which are covered by a single 841989 line. Industry label 'Нефтегаз и химия' is only partly right: the site positions itself primarily for pharma, chemical, fertiliser and defence/aerospace, with no oil & gas line visible; chemical is correct, oil & gas is not corroborated. Role: site presents itself as an engineering/manufacturer ('ATR Facility', 'Glass Making Advantage', 50+ years glass capability) but also states 'Design Supply of Glass Pilot Process Plants' and names 'Solution Engineering Malaysia' as technical partner and lists Thailand/Malaysia/Indonesia presence - i.e. a design-and-supply integrator with outsourced/partner fabrication, hence manufacturer_trader rather than pure manufacturer. Trader signs: turnkey 'supply' wording, foreign technical partner, no plant address or capacity data visible on the pages read. All product claims are website-only: no customs line was available to me in this task, so every HS mapping above is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Credibility flag: the 'Client Testimonial' block on the Glass Reactors page contains unfilled placeholder text ('Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet...', fictional names Leo Ashcroft / Isabella Wren / Nova Blackwood) - the site's marketing content is partly template boilerplate and should not be treated as evidence of deliveries. No registry, revenue or shipment data researched per role scope; PAN/CIN/state not verified here (null).
